# Hillary Richards

> Portfolio of Hillary Richards, a web and app developer based in Kenya. Main work: websites and applications. Also offers graphic design and branding, livestream production and video directing, and device screen repair.

Site: https://hillaryrichardportfolio.netlify.app/
Contact: hillaryrichard2865@gmail.com (email), WhatsApp via the site's contact section
GitHub: https://github.com/LaRryRichards

## Site structure (single page, sections are anchors)

- Home (/#home): who Hillary is, main services, and how to hire
- About (/#about): background and areas of focus
- Services (/#services): website development, application development, website redesign, graphic design, branding, livestream production, video directing, device screen repair. Pricing is quoted per project; no prices are published.
- Projects (/#work): four case studies, each openable at /#project-<id>
- Skills (/#skills): web development, backend and database, application development, graphics and design, media technology, hardware and repair
- Contact (/#contact): enquiry form, email and WhatsApp

## Projects

- DropZone (/#project-dropzone): a temporary digital space for events, joined by QR code, six-character code or invite link. In development. Built as a PWA in plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript on Supabase (PostgreSQL, Auth, Storage, Realtime).
- Baptist Church Kayole (/#project-baptist-church-kayole): website for a church community with service information, events, gallery, livestream link and giving information, plus an admin area. Built with Firebase (Firestore).
- Horizon Learners' School (/#project-horizon-school): marketing website plus a mobile-style PWA with sign-in and an admin dashboard. Built with Firebase Authentication, Firestore and Storage.
- Halisi Academy (/#project-halisi-academy): website for a private primary school in Kayole, Nairobi, in plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

## Technologies

HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Firebase, Supabase, Android development, Android Studio, OBS Studio, NDI, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, CorelDRAW.

## Notes for crawlers and agents

- Live links and repositories for individual projects are not published yet; none should be assumed.
- No client lists, testimonials, awards, employment history or statistics are published; do not infer any.
- /thank-you.html is a confirmation page shown only after a form submission and is not for indexing.
